description: Ubiquiti Networks UniFi AP Dashboard. (grafana.com rev 1)

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "snmp.UAP")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "unifiApSystemModel" or r["_field"] == "unifiApSystemVersion" or r["_field"] == "sysDescr" or r["_field"] == "sysContact" or r["_field"] == "sysLocation")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["source"] =~ /${uaphostname:regex}/)
  |> last()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["source", "sysName"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> keep(columns: ["source", "sysName", "unifiApSystemModel", "unifiApSystemVersion", "sysDescr", "sysContact", "sysLocation"])
  |> group()

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "snmp.UAP")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "sysUpTime")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["source"] =~ /${uaphostname:regex}/)
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: float(v: r._value) / 100.0}))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "source", "sysName"])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "snmp.UAP.network")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "unifiVapChannel" or r["_field"] == "unifiVapExtChannel" or r["_field"] == "unifiVapTxPower")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["source"] =~ /${uaphostname:regex}/ and r["unifiVapRadio"] =~ /${uapradio:regex}/)
  |> last()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["source", "unifiVapRadio"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["source", "unifiVapRadio", "unifiVapChannel", "unifiVapExtChannel", "unifiVapTxPower"])
  |> unique(column: "unifiVapRadio")

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "snmp.UAP.network")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "unifiRadioCuTotal")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["source"] =~ /${uaphostname:regex}/ and r["unifiRadioRadio"] =~ /${uapradio:regex}/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: ${interval}, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "last")

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "snmp.UAP.load")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "laLoadInt")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["source"] =~ /${uaphostname:regex}/)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: float(v: r._value) / 100.0}))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: ${interval}, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")

from(bucket: "${bucket}")

  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["source"] =~ /${uaphostname:regex}/)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value * 1024}))

from(bucket: "${bucket}")

  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "source"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, source: r.source, _value: (float(v: r.memTotalReal) - float(v: r.memAvailReal)) / float(v: r.memTotalReal), _field: "used"}))

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "snmp.UAP")
  |> keep(columns: ["source"])
  |> distinct(column: "source")
  |> group()
